item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 source explicitly showing Jokowi withholding food, housing, permits, or welfare benefits from opponents as a formal tool of political punishment. The evidence is mostly indirect: technocratic service systems on one side, and broader patronage, dynastic politics, and loyalty-driven appointments on the other.","evidence":[{"title":"Indonesia","publisher":"World Health Organization","date":"2024","url":"https://www.who.int/about/accountability/results/who-results-report-2024-2025/country-profile/2024/indonesia","summary":"WHO credits Indonesia with broad health coverage, lower out-of-pocket costs, better access regardless of gender/age/disability, and more efficient, results-oriented, transparent resource management. This supports a technocratic, non-clientelist reading of service delivery.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.4","6B.5","6B.2"]},{"title":"Does Indonesia’s National Health Insurance Scheme mobile phone application, Mobile JKN, support health financing?","publisher":"World Health Organization","date":"2024-12-06","url":"https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240100893","summary":"Mobile JKN simplified registration and payments, improved informal-sector contribution collection, and lowered BPJS administrative costs. That points to service delivery by process improvement, not patronage gating.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.4","6B.5","6B.2"]},{"title":"Less burden, better care: MoH and WHO accelerate JKN redistribution","publisher":"WHO Indonesia","date":"2024-10-29","url":"https://www.who.int/indonesia/news/detail/29-10-2024-less-burden--better-care--moh-and-who-accelerate-jkn-redistribution","summary":"The ministry and WHO used workload ratios, quality standards, and continuous monitoring to redistribute patients and resources across primary-care providers, which is the opposite of loyalty-based allocation.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.4","6B.5","6B.2"]},{"title":"BAPPENAS Perkuat Dukungan untuk Anak-Anak dan Keluarga Rentan","publisher":"UNICEF Indonesia","date":"2024-04-25","url":"https://www.unicef.org/indonesia/id/press-releases/bappenas-perkuat-dukungan-untuk-anak-anak-dan-keluarga-rentan","summary":"Regsosek was presented as a data system to improve targeting, delivery, accountability, and transparency of social assistance for poor and vulnerable households. That is evidence for targeted administration rather than welfare as a loyalty reward.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.4","6B.5","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Blueprint get children back to school in Indonesia","publisher":"UNICEF Indonesia","date":"2024-08-23","url":"https://www.unicef.org/indonesia/stories/blueprint-get-children-back-school-indonesia","summary":"The government-led back-to-school push returned nearly 37,000 children to learning and prevented about 149,000 dropouts since 2021, showing organized outreach aimed at children rather than a patronage-only channel.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Indonesia’s climate ambitions gain boost through World Bank-supported land administration and spatial planning reform","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/09/30/indonesia-s-climate-ambitions-gain-boost-through-world-bank-supported-land-administration-and-spatial-planning-reform","summary":"The reform was meant to strengthen land tenure security, simplify licensing, reduce disputes, and improve productive investment; that is broad, rules-based administration, not an obvious loyalty filter.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.5","5B.6"]},{"title":"Outgoing Indonesian president gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-08-19","url":"https://theprint.in/world/outgoing-indonesian-president-gives-cabinet-jobs-to-loyalists-of-successor-prabowo/2228867/","summary":"Jokowi appointed people close to Prabowo into cabinet roles, which is direct evidence that jobs and offices were still being used in a network-smoothing, patronage-heavy way rather than a pure merit model.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.4","5B.5"]},{"title":"Analysis: A decade of Jokowi, Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-10-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/","summary":"Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi left patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity, which is the strongest broad negative background evidence against a clean separation between public benefits and political loyalty.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.4","5B.5"]},{"title":"World Bank Group debars PT LPPSLH Konsultan","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-07-10","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/10/world-bank-group-debars-pt-lppslh-konsultan","summary":"The bank found overbilling and improper hiring of a project official’s family member, concrete evidence that favoritism persisted inside development implementation.","question_ids":["6B.7","6B.4","5B.5"]}]}
